_help: Curated closure notices shown to everyone. Each entry needs a name and either lat/lon (+ radius_m, default 50) or a polygon [[lat,lon],...]. Dates: use 'from'/'to' (YYYY-MM-DD) for a one-off notice, or 'dates' such as 'March 1 - August 31' for a yearly one. Add 'source' and 'note'. Example (delete the underscore to use): see _example.
